login.title: Sign in with Plex
login.text: Access is limited to users of the Plex server this app runs on.
login.waiting: Waiting for you to sign in in the Plex window…
login.denied: This account has no access to this Plex server.
login.timeout: No confirmation from Plex within 2 minutes
login.expired: the sign-in session expired or was started in another browser

filters.recommendedHint: Picked for you from your Plex watch history

browse.noData: The guide has not been downloaded yet.
browse.noRecommendations: No recommendations: your account has no watch history on this Plex server yet.
browse.recommendationsPending: Recommendations are being prepared from your watch history. Check back in a few minutes.

ignored.title: Hidden
ignored.text: Titles and episodes that no longer show up in the list or in emails.
ignored.confirmClearAll_one: Restore {{count}} hidden entry? Everything will show up in the list again.
ignored.confirmClearAll_other: Restore {{count}} hidden entries? Everything will show up in the list again.

wishlist.title: Wishlist
wishlist.text: When something from this list shows up in the guide, you get an email. For shows, only episodes you don't have yet and aren't scheduled are reported.
wishlist.searchPlaceholder: Type a movie or show title…
wishlist.phraseHint: A phrase matches every title that contains it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.emailHint: Defaults to your Plex account email.
settings.alertsHint: Sent as soon as something from your wishlist appears in the guide.
settings.digestHint: After the nightly refresh: everything new in the guide (excluding hidden, scheduled and titles you have).
settings.smtpMissing: Email is not configured (SMTP_HOST is missing).
settings.recsHint: The 20 best titles to record from the whole guide, picked from your Plex watch history (excluding hidden, scheduled and titles you have).
settings.shortThresholdHint: Recordings shorter than this share of the expected length are listed by the Short recordings tool.

email.alertIntro: These titles from your wishlist showed up in the TV guide:
email.digestIntro: New titles in the guide since the last email:
email.testBody: This email confirms that notifications work.
email.footer: You can change notification settings in RecPick.
email.recsIntro: Picked from the whole guide based on what you watch on Plex:

support.text: Enjoying RecPick? You can buy me a coffee.

rules.text: A rule hides everything that matches all of its conditions: in the list, in alerts, in the daily email and in recommendations. Within one condition (e.g. genres) any of the picked values matches.
rules.name: Name
rules.channelHint: With channels, only the airings on those channels are hidden. A title disappears when it has no airings left on other channels.
rules.missingHint: Titles with no year, rating or country never match those conditions. Pick “Unknown country” to hide titles TMDB doesn't know.
rules.matches_one: Hides {{count}} title in the current guide
rules.matches_other: Hides {{count}} titles in the current guide
rules.fromFiltersHint: Creates a rule that hides what these filters show
rules.missingHintNoTmdb: Titles with no year never match a year condition.

tools.title: Tools
tools.text: Helpers for your Plex library. RecPick only reads it and never changes anything in Plex.
tools.notScanned: The library has not been checked yet.

duplicates.title: Duplicate recordings
duplicates.tile: Episodes and movies stored in the library more than once.
duplicates.text: Episodes and movies that are in the library more than once: as several versions of one item or as separate items. Compare their length and remove the extra copies in Plex.
duplicates.ignoreHint: Hides the group for everyone until its set of copies changes.

short.title: Short recordings
short.tile: Recordings much shorter than they should be.
short.text: Recordings much shorter than they should be. Episodes are compared with the typical length of recordings in their season or show, or with the episode runtime from TMDB when a show has only 1-2 recordings. Movies are compared with their TMDB runtime.
short.textNoTmdb: Episodes much shorter than the typical recording in their season or show. With a TMDB key, movies and shows with only 1-2 recordings are checked too.
short.threshold: Showing recordings shorter than {{threshold}}% of the expected length.
short.ignoreHint: Hides the recording for everyone until its file changes.
short.moviesUnchecked_one: {{count}} movie without a TMDB runtime was not checked.
short.moviesUnchecked_other: {{count}} movies without a TMDB runtime were not checked.
short.wishHint: Adds the movie to your wishlist so you hear about its next airing. Alerts start once the movie is no longer in the library.

script.pathTo: Path on the machine that runs the script
script.allCopies_one: Careful, every copy of {{count}} item is selected:
script.allCopies_other: Careful, every copy of {{count}} items is selected:
script.howTo: RecPick never changes anything itself. Run the downloaded script on the machine with the files: sudo bash recpick-….sh. It lists everything and asks before doing it. Then scan the library in Plex and empty the trash.
script.header: Script from RecPick {{version}}, {{date}}. Afterwards scan the library in Plex and empty the trash.
script.nothing: None of the files exist any more.
script.done: Done. Scan the library in Plex and empty the trash.
script.noPermission: No permission to delete some of the files, nothing was deleted. Run the script with sudo:
script.noFfmpeg: Joining needs ffmpeg and ffprobe (e.g. sudo apt install ffmpeg). Nothing was changed.
script.encodeSlow: Note: the parts differ in format and will be re-encoded, which can take a long time.
script.joinFailed: Joining failed, the parts are kept
script.durationMismatch: The joined file's length doesn't match, the parts are kept
script.howToJoin: RecPick never changes anything itself. Run the downloaded script on the machine with the files: sudo bash recpick-….sh (joining needs ffmpeg). Parts are deleted only once the joined file has the right length. Then scan the library in Plex and empty the trash.

plan.missingPart: part {{part}} is missing, or two copies have the same number
plan.onePart: joining needs at least two parts
plan.differentHint: The files have different episode titles, so these are probably different episodes under one number in Plex. Renumber the file and Plex will move it to the right episode.
plan.tmdbHint: The episode number TMDB gives for the title in the file name. Click to renumber the file to it.
